1.  24-53930  Recommendation to hold an election for the position of Chair and Vice Chair of the
  Commission for Women and Girls.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Nicholson, seconded by , to elect
  Commissioner Mehlinger for Chair of the Commission for Women and Girls.
  The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  9 Allen Harper, Archuleta, Donato-Sapp,  Gonzalez,  Lassiter,
  LaViolette, Mehlinger, Mosqueda, Nicholson
  No:  0 None
  Recused: 0 None
  Abstain: 0 None
  Absent: 2 Anckle, Chey Patterson

  Commissioner Nicholson for Vice Chair of the Commission for Women and

  Alanah Grant, Equity Officer, City Manager Department, declared the nominations
  open for Chair.

  Commissioner Nicholson nominated Commissioner Mehlinger for Chair of the
  Commission for Women and Girls.

  There being no further nominations, Alanah Grant, Equity Officer, City Manager
  Department, declared the nominations closed for Chair.

  Commissioner Mehlinger accepted the Chair of the Commission for Women and
  Girls nomination.

  Alanah Grant, Equity Officer, City Manager Department, declared the nominations
  open for Vice Chair.

  Commissioner Mehlinger nominated Commissioner Nicholson for Vice Chair of the
  Commission for Women and Girls.

  There being no further nominations, Alanah Grant, Equity Officer, City Manager
  Department, declared the nominations closed for Vice Chair.

  Commissioner Nicholson accepted the Vice Chair of the Commission for Women
  and Girls nomination.
